description.value: Papa Joe's Pizza is a local pizza shop in Surrey's Fleetwood neighbourhood, located along Fraser Highway. It offers online and phone ordering for quick pickup, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through this busy suburban corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live (copyright 2025, active contact form) confirming the business is open. A significant phone number discrepancy exists: OSM lists +1-778-592-5550 while the website prominently displays (604) 572-5800 — these are different numbers, so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. The website content is extremely sparse (repeated name/phone/contact form only), providing no evidence for any cycling-specific amenities; the 'Order Now' button is the only strong amenity signal, confirming takeout.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-778-592-5550 but website prominently displays (604) 572-5800. Website value used; OSM tag may be outdated or belong to a different location/owner.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pizza shop confirmed via active website. A convenient food stop for cyclists on Fraser Highway.
